description: This file contains unit tests for the WideAreaGatewayDiscovery component within the OpenClaw project. It includes test cases for discovering beacons and preventing attacker peers from becoming nameservers, utilizing mock environment variables, and simulating network responses.

classes.name: NameserverQueryLog
classes.description: A thread-safe class for logging and counting queried nameservers during tests.

classes.name: WideAreaGatewayDiscoveryTests
classes.description: A test suite containing test cases for WideAreaGatewayDiscovery functionality.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a queried nameserver in the log.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of times a nameserver matching a specific string was queried.

methods.name: `discovers beacon from tailnet dns sd fallback`
methods.description: Tests the discovery of a beacon using Tailnet DNS Service Discovery fallback.

methods.name: `attacker peer cannot become nameserver`
methods.description: Ensures that an attacker peer cannot be incorrectly registered as a nameserver.
